description: Put \(P=p_0\to(p_1\lor p_2)\) and \(Q=(p_0\to p_1)\lor(p_0\to p_2)\). For the specified substitution \(\sigma(p_0)=p_1\lor p_2\) fixing all other atoms, \(P[\sigma]\) is an intuitionistic theorem and \(Q[\sigma]\) is not. Consequently the rule \(P/Q\) is not uniformly substitution-admissible.
